name: Penske Media Corporation (PMC)
verdict: A private US media company; a $200m investment stake from the Saudi state-backed SRMG (2018) is on record, with the stake size undisclosed.
note: DS Penske partner; PMC lists the team among its brands (founder Jay Penske owns the Penske Autosport operation). Rating note: whether SRMG's minority stake reaches 5% or carries a board seat could not be sourced, so no tier (METHOD.md).
